name: Hallways Full of Even More Mostly Illusory Opossums

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-16: Dacilane Academy's First Great Prank War

disable: DC 23 Diplomacy check, DC 23 Deception check, or DC 23 Intimidation check four times to convince one sprite to undo their spells; DC 25 Athletics check, DC 25 Diplomacy check (with wild empathy) or DC 25 Nature check to subdue or soothe the opossums; or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 21) to undo one sprites' worth of spells. Four successes are required to disable the hazard.
routine: (4 actions) The hazard loses 1 action each turn for each Disable success. Each sprite takes one action to Strike a different randomly chosen PC.

items.name: New Targets
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks into the room

---

Effect The sprites scream "Surprise!," attempt a opossum flyby Strike, and roll initiative.

text: Several distressed opossums dressed in school uniforms and under the effects of Mirror Image fly about the hallway, guided by four giggling sprites.
